term: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
definition: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) is a leading conference in the area of natural language processing and artificial intelligence.
details: Along with the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL) and the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (NAACL), it is one of the three primary high impact conferences for natural language processing research. EMNLP is organized by the ACL special interest group on linguistic data (SIGDAT) and was started in 1996, based on an earlier conference series called Workshop on Very Large Corpora (WVLC). As of 2021, according to Microsoft Academic, EMNLP is the 14th most cited conference in computer science, with a citation count of 332,738, between ICML (#13) and ICLR (#15).

explainer.lead: EMNLP is a leading conference for research on natural language processing and artificial intelligence. It is one of the field’s three primary high-impact conferences, making it an important place to follow influential NLP work.

tiers.eli5: EMNLP is like a big yearly show-and-tell for people who teach computers to work with language. Researchers share their discoveries, and others can learn which ideas are attracting attention. It began in 1996 and grew out of an earlier workshop series.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers can use EMNLP proceedings to follow NLP research and compare new methods with earlier work. Treat conference results as research findings rather than guarantees of performance in a production system. Its 2021 citation ranking is a dated snapshot, not a current measure of quality.
tiers.paperLevel: EMNLP is a research venue, not an algorithm or metric. It was started in 1996 from the Workshop on Very Large Corpora series and is organized by SIGDAT, the ACL special interest group on linguistic data. As of 2021, Microsoft Academic counted 332,738 citations and ranked it 14th among computer science conferences, between ICML and ICLR.

explainer.outcome: EMNLP became a leading NLP and AI conference and, alongside ACL and NAACL, one of the three primary high-impact conferences for NLP research.
explainer.whyItMatters: The conference provides a prominent forum for NLP research, and its citation count shows the substantial reach of its published work. Its standing also helps readers place EMNLP papers within the wider research landscape without treating venue prestige as proof that every result will generalize.
